selection: Title-only triage from GitHub repository-scoped issue-search results. Excludes feature suggestions, duplicate queries, pre-inspected CrewAI #7252, LangGraph #6792, OpenAI SDK #4775 and old 3 training issues. IDs and titles seen; NO issue bodies, fix diffs or native outputs viewed before split.

ranking.algorithm: FNV-1a-32 of seed|repo#number, ascending within each repo
ranking.unit: upstream issue not generated test or source function

permission: Read development issue bodies and source only after registry committed; do NOT read sealed confirmation issue bodies, comments, patch diffs or native outcomes. Confirmation issues may have title-level leakage already documented. Status/eligibility must be reported with original denominator. Do not change split after seeing development outputs.

constraints.allowed_implementation: native deterministic test scripts and source AST analysis
constraints.unknown_status: UNKNOWN, never assumed PASS or FAIL
